verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's documented Create Event endpoint can create a new profile or update an existing profile's properties. Its schema-less model accepts arbitrary custom data, and documented rate-limit headers and Retry-After handling support production-scale clients. Suppression and bulk operations are not evidenced. Missing for 10: any documented suppress/unsubscribe-profile API, a dedicated profile create/update endpoint, bulk/batch profile import for scale, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, update, and suppress contacts with custom properties through the API at production scale

citations.quote: Note that this endpoint allows you to create a new profile or update an existing profile's properties.

Since Klaviyo doesn't impose a rigid data schema, it's easy to send in just about any arbitrary data without having to do annoying manipulations or data mappings and without having to pre-configure a data schema in the app.
Klaviyo is also accessible headlessly — through its public APIs and MCP server — so people and AI agents can read, write, and act on Klaviyo data from outside the Klaviyo interface.
